import numpy as np
from tslearn.metrics.cycc import y_shifted_sbd_vec

# Prepare deterministic float64 inputs
ref_ts = np.asarray(X[0], dtype=np.float64)
dataset = np.asarray(X, dtype=np.float64)

# Precompute norms as required by the API
norm_ref = float(np.linalg.norm(ref_ts))
norms_dataset = np.linalg.norm(dataset, axis=(1, 2)).astype(np.float64)

# Compute the shifted dataset
shifted_dataset = y_shifted_sbd_vec(ref_ts, dataset, norm_ref, norms_dataset)

# Verify the output shape matches the input dataset
assert shifted_dataset.shape == (8, 40, 1), f"Expected shape (8, 40, 1), got {shifted_dataset.shape}"

# The first time series in the dataset is identical to the reference, 
# so its optimal shift should be 0 (i.e., it remains unchanged)
assert np.allclose(shifted_dataset[0], ref_ts), "Self-alignment did not return the original reference series"

print(f"__CHECK__ y_shifted_sbd_vec {shifted_dataset.shape}")
